searchText: Is this still up-to-date/accurate? <https://docs.ethhub.io/ethereum-roadmap/ethereum-2.0/eth-2.0-phases/#phase-1-shard-chains> Specifically, that phase 1 shards are basically just mainnet test, not really useful. It is correct that its just sharded data but incorrect that it is just a test Sharded data couples quite well with L2 scalability techniques that scale with layer 1 data So there will be a fee market to get bytes into this data availability machine and its not a just test in the way it describes in that article
